gloss: numerous; a great number of; many

definitions.gloss: numerous; a great number of; many
definitions.explanation: A somewhat formal way to express that there are many of something. Functions as a modifier before nouns.

examples.japanese: {数多|かずおお}くの⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{数多|かずおお}くの⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}んで→積む：02294_tsumu⟧きた。
examples.english: I have accumulated a great deal of experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数多|かずおお}くの⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{世|よ}→世：00424_yo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{送|おく}り{出|だ}して→送り出す：06085_okuridasu⟧きた。
examples.english: This author has produced a great many works.

notes:
{数多|かずおお}くの is a somewhat formal way to say "many" or "numerous," more literary and emphatic than {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or ⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

USAGE:
- Always modifies a noun: {数多|かずおお}くの⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ (numerous problems)
- Can also be used adverbially without ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: ⟦{数多|かずおお}く→数多く：12948_kazuooku⟧⟦{存在|そんざい}する→存在する：17185_sonzaisuru⟧ (to exist in large numbers)

ALTERNATE READING:
⟦{数多|あまた}→数多：15498_amata⟧ — a more literary/archaic reading with the same meaning. ⟦{数多|あまた}→数多：15498_amata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧ (numerous hardships).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: lots of (casual, everyday)
- {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: many (neutral)
- {数多|かずおお}くの: numerous (formal, emphatic)
- ⟦{無数|むすう}→無数：00300_musuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: countless (strongest)

REGISTER:
Written language, speeches, and formal contexts. Rare in casual conversation.
